messages:
noor (product): Quick sync: we need a decision on 'backfill priority' when reserved pools exhaust burst credits and autoscale wants to spin up spot capacity. Customers want predictable latency; finance wants to avoid overprovisioning. Proposals below.

sam (eng-runtime): tl;dr: two modes - conservative (preemptible fill only after x% of burst used) vs aggressive (auto-fill immediately). Conservative preserves baseline latency for reserved tenants; aggressive minimizes failed requests but costs more.

kai (eng-platform): technical constraints: spot pool spinup has ~30-90s cold start depending on region. We can mitigate with warm prewarm agents but that increases cost. Also cross-region fallback adds complexity.

lina (finance): cost view: each aggressive fill can add up. Need pricing offsets. Proposal: charge an "on-demand backfill fee" when we auto-fill beyond committed capacity; otherwise customers bear increased tail risk.

mara (sales): customers will accept a fee if it buys "X seconds at Y qps" of guaranteed latency. They hate surprise billing. We need a clear meter: backfill_seconds or backfill_tokens measured and shown in console. Also want an opt-in per-customer toggle for auto-fill.

zoe (legal): contract implications: fee must be clear and capped in pilot. Also we should add a clause that auto-fill is best-effort and subject to regional capacity. No SLA for auto-filled capacity.

noor (product): suggestion: default conservative mode + paid opt-in aggressive mode. Conservative = allow short-lived spillover for 10s/tenant, then preempt. Aggressive opt-in = auto-fill with backfill-fee and soft SLA. Need gating criteria for GA.

sam (eng-runtime): config sketch:
```
backfill_policy:
  mode: conservative # conservative | aggressive
  spill_seconds: 10
  preempt_order: [reserved, burst_opt_in, best_effort]
  max_concurrent_backfills: 5
```
We'll also add metric backfill_latency and backfill_cost_estimate.

kai (eng-platform): to support aggressive opt-in we need a small warm cache for opt-in tenants. Estimate infra delta: +1 sprint infra to add prewarm plumbing, +1 sprint to add billing hooks.

lina (finance): billing model options:
- flat monthly allotment for backfill seconds
- pay-as-you-go per-second metering (higher unit price)
- capped-overage with alerting
Recommend starting with capped-overage to limit revenue surprises.

mara (sales): pilot ask: offer both flat allotment and capped overage. Sales can take different SKUs to customers to test price elasticity. Need sample language for pilot agreements.

zoe (legal): will draft a short pilot amendment: cap monthly backfill fees during pilot and include explicit non-guarantee language.

noor (product): launch criteria proposal:
- Pilot with 4 customers (mix of chat short-turn, long-context agents, and batch) for 30 days
- Telemetry: backfill_seconds_used, backfill_failures, p95/p99 latency pre/post backfill, cost delta per region
- Safety gates: auto-disable aggressive mode in region if backfill_fail_rate > 0.5% for 4h or cost delta > 200% of forecast
- UX: console shows backfill usage, opt-in toggle, and forecasted monthly cost
- Rollout: start conservative default, enable aggressive as opt-in per-customer after contract signature

sam (eng-runtime): estimate: runtime + scheduler changes + billing = 4 sprints; prewarm infra = 2 sprints if we want warm starts. Pilot MVP (no prewarm) in 6 weeks.

kai (eng-platform): may need to limit pilot to regions with reliable spot capacity. I'll surface regions.

lina (finance): will model expected revenue under both pricing options and provide a recommended floor price in 1 week.

mara (sales): i'll recruit pilot customers and prepare two pitch scripts (flat allotment vs pay-as-you-go).

ops-bot: RFC draft created at https://redwood.internal/rfcs/backfill-priority-and-billing (access: product, eng-runtime, eng-platform, finance, sales, legal).

noor (product): thanks team. Action items: sam prototype config + metrics, kai region suitability, lina pricing model, zoe pilot amendment, mara pilot roster. I'll collect updates next Tuesday.

sam (eng-runtime): ack and starting prototype ticket today.

mara (sales): ack. will ping pilot leads.

zoe (legal): ack. drafting amendment.

noor (product): closing thread. Will post checklist and owners to the RFC doc.
